error[L0100]: a recovery that runs statements opens a block after `else`: write `else begin`

9 |     attempt(n) else
  |                ^^^^
  = note: [1030]: `else value` stands in for the call's result; `else begin` opens a block that closes with `end`, and `else (problem)` opens one that names the error
  = help (guess): write `begin` after `else`
